integrity: The proof applies over the algebraic closure and finite-field counts to every \(q=2^m\). The standalone verifier checks finite instances; it does not certify the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies smooth monic quartic coefficient models in characteristic two, not isomorphism classes. Isogeny does not identify principal polarizations. The plausible 1991 precursor was accessible only as an abstract, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Translation symmetries and the complete Newton stratification of characteristic-two quartic Picard covers
